title: Google Pixel 8a: Features, specs, price
text:
Google Pixel 8a: Features, specs, price

# Meet Pixel 8a: The Google AI phone at an unbeatable value

May 07, 2024

 The Google Pixel 8a delivers Google’s industry-leading AI and beloved Pixel camera experience for $499. 

Soniya Jobanputra

Director of Product Management

The Google Pixel 8a is a new phone with a powerful chip and AI features. It takes great photos and videos, and it can help you get things done faster. It's durable, comes in fun colors, and has a larger storage option. Starting at $499, it's a great value for the price.

The Google Pixel 8a is here! Powered by our latest Google Tensor G3 chip, it's equipped with many of the same must-have AI features as Pixel 8 and Pixel 8 Pro — like Gemini, Best Take, Audio Magic Eraser and more. Designed to capture amazing photos, save you time and help keep your information secure, the Pixel 8a offers unbeatable value starting at $499.

...

There are two new A-series colors: Aloe (a limited-edition color!) and Bay. ... And for the first time ever, there’s a larger storage capacity option at 256 GB, giving you more space for your favorite content.

...

## Get the Pixel 8a, plus more Pixel devices today

The Pixel 8a starts at $499, and you can also pre-order on Google Fi Wireless and get $499 back over 24 monthly credits when you sign up to any plan.

To round out your Pixel lineup, the Pixel Tablet is now available in Spain and Italy. Starting today you can also pre-order the Pixel Tablet without the Charging Speaker Dock for $399. Pixel Tablet continues to bring more help in your hand and in your home with added features like Circle to Search, which will be rolling out later this month. And with the Gemini app coming to Pixel Tablet this summer, it will be even easier to get help for things like planning your next trip or writing emails with your AI assistant. You can score a Pixel Tablet (128 GB) for as low as $0 with an eligible trade-in through the Google Store today through May 20.

Both the Pixel 8a and Pixel Tablet are available for pre-order today and will be available at the Google Store and our retail partners beginning May 14.
